Commentary.Commentary: That wraps up the formalities of the first Test. It looked like an off-beat drama for the first four days but today was certainly an action-packed thriller towards the end. The next Test begins in Vizag on 17th November. Do join us for that one. Action starts at 0930 IST. Until then, it's goodbye from us.

MOEEN ALI (MAN OF THE MATCH) feels that it was a really good pitch. States that he enjoyed batting with Root. Adds that England prepared well for this series with the matches in Bangladesh. Says that he has consciously tried to improve his bowling in the last 3 years. Opines that he can still get better. Lauds his spin partners for not letting the Indian batsmen off the hook. Hopes that they can keep it going throughout the series. States that he is happy with the overall performance of his side.

VIRAT KOHLI feels that the ending was a bit tense but it was also a good opportunity for his side to learn new aspects of the game. Mentions that such mentally testing phases are crucial for a side to succeed as a top team. Adds that India could have done better in the first two days, especially in fielding where several catches were dropped. States that the catching cost his side a lot. Praises England for the strong performance and insists that they never take the visitors lightly. Doesn't feel too unhappy with his team's performance in the game but wants them to iron out the flaws going forward to the next game.

ALASTAIR COOK says that it was a really tough five days. Felt that the toss was vital but adds that execution was more crucial. Says that he is proud of his team, especially the bowlers who didn't let India's batsmen to score quickly. Praises the debutant for the second innings half century. Reveals that the declaration timing was done in such a way that only they could win the game. Mentions that the track was really flat for the first three days and then started to take spin gradually. Feels that all the England spinners were superb and singles out Rashid for a special performance. Ends by saying that it's a performance that England can be proud of.

When England came back to bat, the openers were solid and positive in their approach. Cook and Hameed stitched together a mammoth 180 run-stand before the latter tried to up the ante and missed out on his century on debut. However, Cook carried on and it was a special century that helped England set a target of 310. England had a go at the hosts with 49 overs remaining in the day. They just fell short by four wickets to register what would have been a magnificent victory.

India came out and gave a solid reply with the bat. Pujara and Vijay stitched together a marathon 209-run stand and hit brilliant centuries. Ashwin down the order, batted intelligently with the tail and scored a brilliant half century to take India close to 500. However, India conceded a lead of 49 to the visitors. Rashid was the star as he produced a brilliant display of spin bowling to take four wickets. Woakes tested the Indian batsmen constantly with his disciplined lines and lengths but was unlucky to not get any reward.

Earlier in the match, England batted superbly to notch up 537 on the board. They rode high on the back of centuries from Root, Ali and Stokes. Indian bowlers were made to toil hard on a good batting track. Jadeja was the most successful with three wickets.

It turned out to be a cracker of a match in the end. A half an hour earlier declaration may have seen the English side sneaking in a victory. Rashid weaved his magic around and took three crucial wickets to put immense pressure on India. Other bowlers played the perfect foil to him and kept the batsmen on their toes. Virat Kohli was the one who stood like a thorn and steered the home side to safe lands and Jadeja enjoyed himself in the end.
Kohli and Cook are having a chat. Yes, the handshakes are out. That's officially the end of the first Test of this lengthy 5-match series between India and England. MATCH HAS BEEN DRAWN.

All the England bowlers barring Ansari impressed in the short burst so far. Rashid once again got the ball to turn from uncomfortable lengths and has asked questions of the batsmen. Vijay and Pujara were dropped respectively which can be said as the only blemish by England in this session. Another 8 wickets needed for the tourists to win, India need 261 more and there are 31 overs left in the game. No prizes for guessing where this match is finishing. Join us in a while for the final session of the game.

Superb session for England. They first rattled up quick runs before declaring, thereby setting the hosts an improbable target of 310 from a minimum of 49 overs. Game is still heading for a draw but the hosts should not be complacent.

Full on middle, defended nicely.
Vijay presses forward and pushes it with the spin to covers.

FOUR! THAT CAME RIGHT FROM THE SCREWS! Ansari is lucky to be alright after taking the hard blow. Tosses it up at the stumps, Vijay hits it hard back to Ansari. He still goes for the catch and it deflects from his fingers past the umpire who has to sway away. It still has pace to reach the boundary.
Vijay defends it against the spin to mid-wicket.
FOUR! SHOT! Tossed up on middle, Vijay comes down the track and lofts it over wide mid on. It came off the toe end of the bat and rolls through to the boundary. He hits those shots really well!
On a length on off, Vijay stays back and pushes it to short cover.
Short of a length ball outside off, Pujara camps back and plays it with an angled blade to point.
Back of a length ball at the stumps, Che hangs back and defends it down the track.
Short of a length ball directed at the body, Vijay rises with the bounce and tucks it past the diving leg gully fielder to his left for a single.
On a good length on off, stays a bit low. Vijay hops back and keeps it out to the covers.
On a length outside off, Murali points his bat skywards and leaves it alone.
Back of a length ball outside off, rises up appreciably after pitching. Vijay watches it closely and lets it go.
WELL BOWLED! Quicker one on just outside off, Pujara plants his front leg forward to cover the off pole and lets it through.
Full on off, Pujara puts his head down and defends solidly.
Outside off, driven firmly to the man at mid off.
Pujara comes down the track and drives it wide of mid on against the spin.
Tossed up on off, defended past short leg.
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Tossed up on off, spins away a bit. Pujara leans forward and drives it nicely through extra cover for a superb boundary.
ZAFAR ANSARI to roll his arm over.
Dug in short outside off, Vijay has to sway away from the line quickly to evade it.
Hurls it on a length angling into middle and leg, Vijay is unsure once again as he just manages to fend it off to short leg.
On a length outside off, Murali stays back and hangs his bat at it tamely. Gets beaten all ends up!
Good length ball at the stumps, zips through the pitch. Vijay is surprised by the extra bounce as he takes his bottom hand off and defends it.
On a length on off, stays low after pitching. Vijay is up on his toes as he manages to block it out.
Back of a lenth ball angling in on leg stump, Pujara camps back and tucks it through backward square leg for a single.
Fullish ball angling in on off, Murali clips it wide of mid on. Looks for a single but it is not on.
FOUR! WELL PLAYED! Back of a length ball outside off, Vijay stays back and steers it past the slip cordon. The fielder rushes after it but the ball wins the race in the end!

Shortish delivery on middle, Vijay swivels across and looks to pull it but gets an inside edge onto his body and it just lands in front of the fielder at short leg whose initial reaction to evade the shot.
Fullish ball outside off, Vijay strides ahead and defends it to the covers.

FOUR! SHEER CLASS! Fuller length ball outside off. Vijay leans into it and times his push to perfection. Gets it through the point region and the ball rolls towards the boundary. Ansari sprints after it and puts a slide but can't prevent the boundary.
Full length ball around off, Murali strides forward and defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! THAT'S CREAMED! Overpitched outside off, Che lunges forward and drives it elegantly through extra cover. The ball races to the fence! First runs for Pujara and also for India!
Dug in short, Pujara ducks underneath it.
On a good length on off, Pujara hangs back and defends it towards mid on.
Shortish on middle and off, Cheteshwar camps back and defends it towards mid on.
Shortish delivery outside off, Pujara drops his wrists and watches it closely to let it through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Pujara camps back and defends it solidly down the track.
Dug in short on leg stump, Vijay ducks under the bumper.
Good length around off, Vijay hangs back to that one and blocks it out.
Back of a length around off, climbs on Vijay who looks to fend. The ball goes up off the bat handle but falls safely.
Length ball around off, blocked well off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
Short of a length on middle and leg, worked off the back foot towards short leg.
Fuller on off, Vijay looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards cover.

OUT! WOAKES DRAWS FIRST BLOOD! Brainfade from Gambhir. Short of a length around off, climbs on the southpaw and he just dabs at it. The ball flies off the edge towards second slip where it is easily taken. Duck for Gambhir. What a start for England this is! Must say that it was a very poor shot though.
Length ball outside off, Gambhir leans into it and defends it to the off side.
Full and outside off, Gambhir drives it firmly to the covers.
Short ball and Gambhir ducks under the bumper.
Good length around off, blocked well off the front foot.
Full and outside off, Gambhir blocks it well off the front foot towards point.
CHRIS WOAKES to share the new ball.
Very full and around off, Vijay bunts it straight back to the bowler. Maiden to start the innings.
Length ball on off, blocked off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
Yorker on off, angled in, Vijay gets across and digs it out just in time.
Full and outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Full and around off, Vijay blocks it solidly off the front foot.
Fuller on off, Vijay flicks it towards short mid-wicket. It was a bit uppish.
